// diagnostic

L0102

Parameter `{name}` is never used.

What

Parameter `{name}` is never used.

Why

An unused parameter often means the function contract or implementation is incomplete; Jet keeps this warning-only so prototypes stay unblocked.

Fix

Use `{name}`, rename it to `_{name}` when it is intentionally unused, or remove it from the function contract.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0102: tests/ui_lint/l2401_method_bool.warn.

Warning [L2401] (positional_bool_parameter): Public method `listen` has a positional `Bool` parameter `blocking`
  --> tests/ui_lint/l2401_method_bool.jet:6:25
    |
  6 |     pub fn listen(self, blocking: Bool) -> Int { 0 }
    |                         ^^^^^^^^
 Why: Positional booleans are easy to transpose at the call site
 Fix: Callers can write `blocking: true` to make the intent clear (S61 labels)
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L2401
